data.notes: June 2026 is unusually strong for Tokyo, spanning Tokyo Dome-scale J-pop/K-pop, global R&B and pop, and several credible house/techno signature parties.

events.title: NiziU Live with U 2026 “NiziU : THE CINEMA”
events.summary: NiziU brings its dome-scale “NiziU : THE CINEMA” tour to Tokyo Dome on June 13 and 14. The official NiziU schedule lists both Tokyo dates and show times.

events.title: Janet Jackson Japan 2026 - Yokohama Dates
events.summary: Janet Jackson’s Japan-only 2026 concert run includes two nearby Yokohama arena shows on June 13 and 14. The official Ticket Port page confirms K-Arena Yokohama dates, times and special guests.

events.title: IVE World Tour ‘SHOW WHAT I AM’ in Japan
events.summary: IVE returns to Tokyo Dome with its ‘SHOW WHAT I AM’ world tour. The IVE Japan official site confirms the June 24 Tokyo Dome performance and ticket presale information.

events.title: 81 Music Festival
events.summary: The debut 81 Music Festival takes place at TOYOTA ARENA TOKYO with THE KID LAROI, R3HAB, MRAK, John Martin, Vini Vici b2b MR.BLACK, Night Tempo and more. The official festival site confirms the full lineup and June 27 date.

events.title: Global Citizen Live: Tokyo
events.summary: Global Citizen’s first Japan music event is headlined by &TEAM, with AI and Yuki Chiba also on the bill. The official event page confirms June 18 at Tokyo International Forum.

events.title: Sandaime J SOUL BROTHERS presents “JSB LAND ~FOREVER~”
events.summary: Sandaime J SOUL BROTHERS bring the JSB LAND ~FOREVER~ production to Tokyo Dome across June 27 and 28. The LDH Perfect Year 2026 page lists the Tokyo Dome dates.

events.title: Daniel Caesar - Son of Spergy Tour
events.summary: Daniel Caesar brings his Son of Spergy Tour to Tokyo International Forum Hall A for a one-night Tokyo concert. The official Live Nation H.I.P. page lists the June 4 date and 19:00 start.

events.title: Manhattan Portage presents Body&SOUL Live in Japan 2026
events.summary: The long-running Body&SOUL Japan gathering returns to Toyosu with resident legends Joe Claussell, Danny Krivit and François K. RA confirms the June 7 daytime event at Kiranah Garden Toyosu.

events.title: ACiD: A Concept in Dance – I Hate Models
events.summary: ACiD turns WOMB into a hard-techno/rave environment led by I Hate Models, with Risa Taniguchi, Albino Sound and Tokyo house/tech-house support floors.

events.title: Seiko Matsuda Concert Tour 2026
events.summary: Seiko Matsuda plays two Tokyo Ariake Arena dates on June 6 and June 7. The venue calendar confirms the concert times and official artist-site link.

events.title: NU Festival 2026 Day 2: NU LIVE × Sónar Sound
events.summary: A forward-looking urban festival collaboration with Sónar featuring Actress, DJ Krush, Nathan Fake, Grandbrothers, Sapphire Slows and more across electronica, bass, ambient and art/technology programming.

events.title: MIDNIGHT EAST presents Stones Throw 30 Years Tokyo supported by HUF
events.summary: Stones Throw marks its 30th anniversary in Tokyo with Peanut Butter Wolf, Knxwledge, Mndsgn and Michi. The RA listing confirms the June 6 late-night event at MIDNIGHT EAST in Shibuya.

events.title: SOUNDGATE - Techno / House -
events.summary: ZEROTOKYO brings together major Japanese electronic figures Takkyu Ishino, Shinichi Osawa, Yoshinori Sunahara, tofubeats and more across techno, house, hard techno, trance and open-format rooms.

events.title: KULU Asia Tour 2026 Tokyo with Âme Live
events.summary: KULU’s Asia Tour takes over all floors of WOMB with Âme Live as special guest. WOMB’s official page confirms the June 20 date and 23:00–04:30 timing.

events.title: KULU Asia Tour 2026 Tokyo: Âme Live
events.summary: Traveling party collective KULU’s Asia Tour takes over all floors of WOMB with Âme Live for an Innervisions-rooted night of melodic house, techno, disco and ambient electronics.

events.title: Peter Van Hoesen, Ness / LDG 10th Anniversary
events.summary: Liquid Drop Groove marks its 10th anniversary at VENT with Peter Van Hoesen and Ness alongside YUTA, UG, Shinsuke Goto, Aksamit and Lisa Mizuno for a serious deep/hypnotic techno night.

events.title: INTERFACE
events.summary: A high-energy techno/trance ZEROTOKYO party featuring Drunken Kong and psy-trance legend Tsuyoshi Suzuki, plus multi-room techno and psychedelic-trance programming.

events.title: HOUSETRIBE 11th Anniversary
events.summary: WOMB’s tech-house party HOUSETRIBE celebrates its 11th anniversary with Mixed Methods, Yamariki, CARTOON, Daitto, Chika Luna and others. Resident Advisor lists the event for Friday, June 5 at WOMB.

events.title: Solstice Music presents GMS & 1200 Micrograms
events.summary: Solstice Music brings full-on/psytrance heavyweight GMS and 1200 Micrograms by Riktam to ZEROTOKYO with a supporting trance lineup.

events.title: AGARTHA
events.summary: A large multi-floor queer party at ZEROTOKYO with AGARTHA, Pride Gate, 9monsters anniversary programming, go-go performers, drag, house/pop floors and a dedicated techno room.
